findings.title: Required delivery evidence remains incomplete
findings.rationale: The package proves a local disposable candidate only. It explicitly lacks the required preserved-runtime migration/source-image validation, operator-assisted own-channel initial sends and replies, remote CI evidence, canonical full diff guard, final review/debt/module closeout, and DOD-11 through DOD-13 evidence. Local E64 success, fake-provider coverage, and image build evidence cannot substitute for those gates.
findings.suggested_action: Keep the TODO and delivery state Pending. Execute the remaining gates in their approved order, including any separately authorized canonical diff inspection and preserved-local activation; record passed, blocked, or failed evidence without converting the local candidate into a delivery claim.
